entries.title: Molecular representation and spatial mechanisms
entries.description: Choose atomic, residue, surface or schematic geometry according to the biological claim and preserve source identity.
entries.provenance: Authored guidance grounded in installed animlib API contracts, reusable helpers and bounded reviewed examples.
limitations: The technique must be adapted to the supplied data and installed host capabilities.
Existing representative proofs do not approve every new scene or scientific claim.

applicableClaims: Selected deposited structure and explicitly identified representation.
Illustrative rigid subunit placement preserving intrapart distances.
excludedClaims: Measured molecular dynamics or folding trajectories.
Atomic contacts from backbone anchors; reconstructed missing residues or biological assemblies.
requiredInputs: Exact asset or PDB accession, selected chains and source identity.
Explicit representation and scientific question; pivot and supplied or illustrative keyframes for motion.
reuseContract.preparationRoute: Use publish_model for supported PDB inputs; retain source hash, CCD hashes, converter version, exact chains and representation in immutable prepared artifacts.
motionLimitations: s.rigidMotion supplies a seekable rigid pose, not molecular deformation or a dynamics solver.
Label authored transforms illustrative; supplied transforms retain their source and do not alone prove dynamics.
fallbackComposition: Research and prepare the exact required structure when identity or representation differs.
Compose annotated schematic primitives for unsupported claims with explicit schematic labels; never silently substitute an asset.

entries.title: Nucleic pairing, processing and translation
entries.description: Stage complementarity, incorporation, cut/join topology and carrier transfer using explicit IDs and event boundaries.
entries.provenance: Authored guidance grounded in installed animlib API contracts, reusable helpers and bounded reviewed examples.
limitations: The technique must be adapted to the supplied data and installed host capabilities.
Existing representative proofs do not approve every new scene or scientific claim.

applicableClaims: Illustrative transcription, pairing, splicing and nucleic mechanism stages from explicit sequence and schedules.
excludedClaims: Measured molecular dynamics or folding trajectories.
Atomic contacts from backbone anchors; reconstructed missing residues or biological assemblies.
requiredInputs: Explicit nucleotide sequence, stable nucleotide IDs, antiparallel strand directions and complementary pairing.
Selected mechanism and absolute-time event schedule with mechanism-specific parameters, source/recipe provenance and required path/aperture inputs.
reuseContract.preparationRoute: Use existing nucleic builders with explicit sequence, pairing and kinematic schedule; prepared deposited models require exact publication identity separately.
motionLimitations: Returned states, anchors and bonds provide schematic kinematics, not reaction dynamics or a general collision solver; translation does not predict protein folding.
Derive geometry from returned connectivity; verify incorporation, cut/join, transfer, stop/release boundaries, bounded clearance and deterministic reverse seeking.
fallbackComposition: Prepare a new explicit sequence, pairing and schedule through the chosen transcription, processing or translation builder.
Use annotated schematic primitives for unsupported mechanisms and separate exact-source evidence for stronger chemistry claims.

entries.title: Rigid molecular subunit motion
entries.description: Seekable pivoted translation and rotation of prepared model parts with explicit illustrative or supplied provenance.
entries.provenance: Original mathematical rigid transform helper; input provenance remains supplied or illustrative.
limitations: Rigid movement preserves intrapart geometry and cannot explain folding or molecular dynamics.
